id: title:dmarchuk:email admins on aws ses tenant reputation changes

review.posthog_relevance: Adds AWS SES account reputation monitoring, tenant state reconciliation, and email suspension warning workflows to protect PostHog users from delivery failures and reputation damage.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation of SES account reputation polling, tenant state reconciliation, and email notification workflows. P1.F11.H1 and P1.F15.H1 show the core periodic task and webhook registration. P1.F16.H1 adds tests for SNS verification. P1.F11.H1 and P1.F15.H1 establish the operational path for checking AWS SES status and updating PostHog.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is incomplete; it lacks the actual implementation of the periodic reconciliation task and the SES account reputation polling, relying on an import rather than showing the full execution and recovery logic. observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration setting for SNS topic ARNs, with a comment explaining the allowlist's role in distinguishing AWS-originated messages from our specific topics.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration is used by the webhook handler to validate the incoming SNS message's TopicArn, preventing messages from unconfigured or unauthorized SNS topics from triggering tenant state reconciliation.

observations.behavior: Adds a new scheduled task, send_email_sending_reputation_finding, which sends an email warning to team admins when SES raises reputation findings.
observations.posthog_connection: This task is triggered by the SES account reputation polling and the webhook, and is responsible for notifying customers of potential email sending suspension, distinguishing between low and high impact findings.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for the SES tenant state reconciliation task.
observations.posthog_connection: This import is required for the periodic task registration, which will call the reconciliation task to fetch the authoritative SES tenant state and trigger any necessary email notifications.

observations.behavior: Adds a Celery task and its periodic backstop, plus the webhook and unit tests, to react to AWS SES tenant status changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether the SES tenant state has changed and, if so, triggers email notifications and updates the tenant's sending status. This could help PostHog users receive timely alerts when AWS SES suspends or reinstates their sending reputation, potentially preventing delivery failures or reputation damage.
